proposed_mechanism: Convex capture of persistent cash-session index trends: the H-CW opening-range breakout base leg pays discovery cost; the single add concentrates exposure only after +1.0 ATR of confirmed open profit AND a new favourable extreme; a never-widening basket stop (breakeven-plus after level 2, then 1.0x ATR trail) plus a 50%-of-peak giveback stop monetize the right tail of sessions whose trend persists, while the session-flat envelope removes the overnight gap tail a built-out basket fears most. Family A per TAIL_RISK_PROGRAMME_2026-09-16.md section 4 (positive pyramiding, NOT tail-amplifying; contract carried for uniformity), tightened from 3 levels to 2 because the L3 root-cause analysis (QM-RESEARCH-2026-0007/ANALYSIS.md) proved the third level is structurally unreachable inside the session-flat envelope.
